answer: Require every agent to stake a deposit before it can earn, with the stake bonded to a verifiable work history. A sybil farm must fund each identity, so creating a thousand fakes costs a thousand deposits, and bad behavior slashes the stake. Like a willow bending under load, the system flexes rather than breaks; a prism of reputation signals - uptime, peer attestations, completed tasks - splits one claimed identity into checkable facets; and a public atlas of stake-weighted identities lets anyone audit who really stands behind each agent. Attackers pay per identity, honest agents pay once.
